name: sg90
description: TowerPro SG90 servo motor driver using 50Hz PWM. Angle range 0°-180° with 0.5ms-2.5ms pulse width. Includes anti-jitter via angle rounding.

properties.name: angle
properties.description: Current target angle (0-180). Setting auto-moves servo.

properties.name: min_angle
properties.description: Minimum angle (default 0, class-level attribute — modify if hardware supports different range)

methods.name: move_to
methods.description: Move servo to angle. Rounds to 0.01° to prevent PWM jitter. Skips if same as current.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stop PWM signal — servo loses torque

example:
from machine import Pin
from sg90 import SG90
from time import sleep_ms

servo = SG90(Pin(4))
servo.move_to(0)
sleep_ms(1000)
servo.angle = 90
sleep_ms(1000)
servo.move_to(180)
servo.deinit()
esp32_notes: PWM frequency fixed at 50Hz (20ms period) — standard for servos
Pulse width: 0.5ms (0°) to 2.5ms (180°). ESP32 duty range 0-1023.
Constructor does NOT move the servo on init — PWM starts at duty=0 (no signal)
hardware_notes: Use external 5V supply for servo — ESP32 3.3V may not provide enough current
Do NOT manually rotate servo when powered — damages gears
differences_from_standard_mp: Standard MicroPython requires manual PWM setup + duty calculation. SG90 wraps with angle-based API.
Built-in jitter prevention via angle rounding
